claims.object_text: increased expression and immunoreactivity in hippocampus
claims.quote: Diabetes increased the expression and immunoreactivity of KIF1A and KIF5B in the hippocampus, but no alterations in dynein were detected.

claims.object_text: increased number of fluorescent accumulations of KIF1A in axons of hippocampal neurons after high glucose
claims.quote: Nevertheless, high glucose increased the number of fluorescent accumulations of KIF1A and synaptotagmin-1 and decreased KIF5B, SNAP-25 and synaptophysin immunoreactivity specifically in axons of hippocampal neurons.

claims.object_text: anterograde axonal transport mediated by these kinesins may be impaired in hippocampal neurons
claims.quote: These changes suggest that anterograde axonal transport mediated by these kinesins may be impaired in hippocampal neurons
